title: Irregular Cycles
content: A cycle is considered clinically irregular if its length varies significantly from month to month (e.g., varying by more than 20 days), or falls outside the typical 21-35 day range. Common non-medical causes of temporary irregularity include high stress, extreme exercise, significant weight changes, travel, or starting/stopping hormonal birth control. Persistent irregularity can be related to conditions like PCOS or thyroid imbalances.
